notes: Legal entity is Emerald Therapeutics, Inc. on EDGAR (CIK 1501852, Delaware, incorporated 2009). Its last Form D was filed in 2014, so every later round is from aggregators (Caplight, Seedtable, SP-Edge) and is unverified. Aggregator totals: USD 181.25M (Caplight) and USD 152M (PitchBook).
The company launched the ECL service in 2014 and spun the therapeutics business out in 2016 (Wikipedia). Its own press page says 'Founded in 2016', meaning the cloud lab business.

HQ moved from South San Francisco to 15500 Wells Port Drive, Austin TX. The move was announced 2021-08-31 (PR Newswire) and again 2023-02-28 (105,000 sq ft facility). A WARN notice for 30 jobs followed in April 2023.

Carnegie Mellon paid about USD 40M for its own cloud lab, built on ECL's design (announced 2021, opened about 2023-24). That is customer or partner money, not ECL equity, so it is left out of the funding table.

Team-page counts are photo tiles with first names only. No titles are shown, so roles are department groups. The 2026-09-10 Wayback capture did not render the member list; the live page was used for 2026-10.

Current openings could not be counted. The careers page loads positions client-side, and no public Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Workable or Recruitee board answered for 'emeraldcloudlab'. A third-party aggregator (bouncewatch) claimed 9 openings in 2026-06, unverified.
